templates.notes: A counterpart's answer to an offer. {terms} is the offer on the table; {top_demand} what they ask instead; {term_they_dislike} the term that costs them most; {red_line} their in-character refusal.

templates.notes: A counterpart opening a session of talks.

lines.text: Good to see you again, {counterpart_title}. Let's get something done.
Welcome. Whatever we decide today, I'm glad we're talking.
My friend. Sit down, let's see what we can build.

templates.notes: A counterpart leaving talks: lost face (hostile) or lost patience (cold).

lines.text: We've talked enough. Call me when you have something new.
I'm going home. There's nothing more to discuss today.
We see no purpose in continuing today. My delegation will withdraw.
I won't be humiliated at this table. We're leaving.

templates.notes: A counterpart's own proposal, demand, offer of trade talks or request to renegotiate. Kinds: proposal, demand, trade_talks, renegotiation.
